# REL002: lockstep-version-mismatch

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | REL |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

Crates or the wheel whose version differs from the workspace version.

Every crate and the wheel are released at one version, so a crate left behind (or
ahead) means a published crate set that cannot be installed together. The workspace
version is `[workspace.package] version`; a member inheriting it with
`version.workspace = true` is equal by construction. A wheel whose version is dynamic
under the `maturin` backend reads `Cargo.toml` and is equal by construction too. A manifest
that cannot be parsed is reported Unresolved with the reason.

## Remedy

Run `frob release cut VERSION`, which sets every crate and the wheel to VERSION in
one commit (`frob release bump VERSION` rewrites the versions alone), or make the named
member inherit the workspace version with `version.workspace = true`.

## Examples

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / One crate left at an older version fires #1 (line 11) (fire)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob 0.532.0
crate frob-ack 0.531.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / The wheel left at an older version fires #2 (line 19) (fire)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob inherit
wheel 0.531.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / Without a workspace version the straggler is still named #3 (line 27) (fire)

```text
workspace -
crate a 0.2.0
crate b 0.2.0
crate c 0.1.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / Every crate at the workspace version is clean #4 (line 36) (clean)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob 0.532.0
crate frob-ack 0.532.0
wheel 0.532.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / Inherited versions and a maturin dynamic wheel are clean #5 (line 45) (clean)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob inherit
crate frob-ack inherit
wheel dynamic
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / A repository with no wheel metadata is clean #6 (line 54) (clean)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob inherit
```
